The given operator is a second-order differential operator of the form

$$
D(y)={f}_{2}(x)\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}+{f}_{1}(x)\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+{f}_{0}(x)y
$$

with ${f}_{2}=x,{f}_{1}=-1,$ and ${f}_{0}=0.$

To compute $D(y),$ we apply the definition of the operator $D$ to the function $y$:

$$
\begin{aligned}D(y) & =D(\frac{1}{x}) \\  & =(x\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}-\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x})\frac{1}{x} \\  & =x\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}(\frac{1}{x})-\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\frac{1}{x}) \\  & =x\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-\frac{1}{{x}^{2}})-(-\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}) \\  & =x\cdot (\frac{2}{{x}^{3}})+\frac{1}{{x}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{2}{{x}^{2}}+\frac{1}{{x}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{3}{{x}^{2}}\end{aligned}
$$
